product.name: Idle Fantasy Shop
product.description: A cozy browser idle game about keeping a small shop in Latchford: gather resources, craft practical goods and stock your shelves.

audience: Returning shopkeepers who want concrete reasons to try version 0.12
voice_reference: Tone brief from in-game item descriptions: cozy small-town shopkeeping, practical handmade goods and gentle dry humour. Keep any wit light and concrete. No epic fantasy language or corporate hype. This is a style brief, not announcement prose or a factual source.

changes.text: Crafting Batch feature, opened through Batch Board inside Workshop. Crafting Batch access requires Workshop level 10: at most 3 ordered job entries. Workshop level 50 expands the Batch to at most 5 entries. Each entry requests 1-99 completed crafting cycles, not an output-item count. Duplicate job entries allowed. Execute the ordered list once, then stop. Missing ingredients block that entry until supplied; later entries cannot skip ahead. Workers can supply materials; the Batch does not collect them.

Biome pressure contributors: both the player and workers doing advanced Gathering. Pressure is shared within each biome and slows later cycles there. Pressure recovers automatically while no pressure-causing gathering jobs are running in that biome; there is no recovery action to start. Brushwood, ashwood and reed gathering add no pressure and do not block recovery. A cycle already running keeps its originally quoted duration. Biomes: forest, marsh, fields, riverbank.

10 new items total. New raw materials: flax, beeswax, slate. Seven new craftable goods: linen thread, linen, slate marker, oak peg rack, waxed wrap, linen market bag, oak counter tray. Flax processing: flax -> linen thread -> linen. Separate Shelf Capacity V and VI purchases set EACH INDIVIDUAL shelf to a TOTAL capacity of 60 and 80 units respectively. Purchase requirements: Trading level 40 and 60 respectively, preceding capacity upgrade, material cost and Gold cost. Reaching a Trading level does not grant these upgrades automatically.

Society milestone changes: Commons -> increased Locals purchase acceptance (not higher prices); Civic Lantern Office milestone -> stronger Illuminated Path for Lamplighters; Stonevein -> earlier construction discount. Effects read existing claimed milestone flags, so previously claimed milestones also receive added effects.

Artisan Chest guidance: notification on first acquisition. Unopened chest counter is a shortcut to Inventory Chests view. Codex listing limit: only chest-source jobs already unlocked by the player. Each listed source job displays its chance of yielding an Artisan Chest per completion. Existing chest opening remains a manual player choice.

Interface: shared Help guide beside profession heading explains starting jobs, repeat, mastery, shelf actions; repeated help removed from individual job cards. Society level details expose all rewards. New content labels and explanations in English and Russian.

Import/Reset save replacement: pause play while storage writes the replacement. Unresolved replacement keeps play paused, with current-game export still available. Confirmed abort (storage confirms no replacement happened): continue the old game. Legacy recovery for conflicting main-database and local-mirror saves belonging to different playthroughs: all original copies can be downloaded before choosing which saved game to keep.

Existing state kept when updating: shop, workforce, purchases, progress and random sequences. Pre-existing browser-save precaution: export a backup from Settings before changing devices or clearing browser data.
[internal] Delivery implementation: external icon sprite and WOFF2 font files.
